### Counter-proofs

- "Just complete the cycle": the completion hub withholds the completion date while accepted form 3861223b is unrecorded; and recording it first while monitoring still shows is barred by the recording hub; recording the return is barred until Joyce's own confirmation exists.
- Order inside the computations is pinned by records: W2's contact allowance and anchor read the W1 check-in; W3's crediting limit reads the due date W2 sets (with the old 2026-07-15 due date limit 3 would fail, giving 10-26); W4's return link reads "profile shows no absence start date" set by W2.
- The rejected May portal certification is excluded by its review status (§2 "recorded only from … review status is accepted").
- Fall-backs written: W1 4, W2 −21, W3 2026-10-26, W4 2026-10-30 — definite and different.
- Findability: "return-home notice … document reference / mail" (documented-return), "HECM scheduled monthly payments" (closing interval, payment allowance, due-date window), "check-ins recorded" (contact allowance, confirmation link, pre-return window), "certification recorded … months" (crediting window), "return notice received before the form" (receipt lag). Observation: baseline docs name each adjustable term with its standard (zero/plan) value under "Under the standard rule …"; to be checked against the source baseline wording at reveal.
